name: search_data
title: Search data sets
description: Searches data sets in the openLCA database by name and returns compact references (@type, @id, name, category, and type specific fields like flowType, refUnit, or location). Use this to find existing flows, processes, units, locations etc. before creating new data sets; new data sets should reference existing ones wherever possible. All words of the query must occur in the name (case-insensitive). Results are ranked: exact matches first, then names starting with the query, then shorter names.

type.description: The data set type to search; if omitted, all types are searched.

query.description: Words that must occur in the name; if empty, all data sets of the type are listed. An exact @id is matched too.

category.description: Optional category path prefix, e.g. 'Elementary flows/Emission to air'.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0).
